result:
I've fixed F-DG1-136 and F-DG1-217. The checks the assignment asked for all passed, but the F-DG1-136 fix hasn't been shown to hold under a slow, contended runner. I changed only the three permitted files and committed nothing. Base: `HEAD` `cc6fbe3e`.

**F-DG1-136 (integration teardown timeout):** in `vitest.config.ts`, the integration project now has `hookTimeout: 30_000`, matching `testTimeout`, with a comment citing F-DG1-136. Before, hooks got vitest's default 10 s. That's the same as the most `dropScratchDatabase()` can wait internally, so a slow teardown could time out. I didn't change that internal wait or the test. In my run the whole `access-derived-race.test.ts` file took 613 ms, so it didn't reproduce the slow case from round 14. The run shows no regression and no hook timeout, nothing more.

**F-DG1-217 (lint crash on `.d.ts` files):** I took the preferred approach, so declaration files are still checked. In `architecture.testkit.ts`, `.d.ts`, `.d.mts` and `.d.cts` files no longer go through `ts.transpileModule`, which crashed on those names with `Debug Failure`. Instead they get a syntax-only check through TypeScript's public API, with nothing emitted, resolved or type-checked. Other files take the same path as before.
- A type import that reaches into another module's internals from a `.d.ts` is still flagged.
- A real syntax error now appears as a named `unparseable source: Type expected. (line 1)` diagnostic.
- Grammar errors that only the type checker reports (such as an initializer on a `declare`) aren't caught. The rest of the rule is also syntax-only.

**New tests in `architecture.test.ts`:**
- For all three extensions: valid source returns `[]` without throwing; a cross-module `import type` gets the expected violation; a syntax error gives the named diagnostic and never `Debug Failure`.
- A `.d.ts` planted in a temp directory is found and checked end to end.

Both new tests fail against the old testkit with `Debug Failure. Output generation failed` and pass with the fix.

**Checks I ran** (offline, no `pnpm install`):

| Check | Node | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm vitest run apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts` | 24.21.0 | 130/130 passed |
| Integration suite on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.13 (port 54917) | 24.21.0 | 200/200 passed, no "Hook timed out" |
| `pnpm -r typecheck` | 24.21.0 | passed |
| `pnpm lint` | 24.21.0 | passed |
| `prettier --check` on the edited files | 24.21.0 | passed |
| `pnpm test` | 22.22.2 | 323/323 passed |
| `pnpm test` | 24.21.0 | 323/323 passed |

The default `node` here is 24, so I ran the Node 22 test pass with `/opt/node22/bin` first on `PATH`; everything else ran on Node 24.

No migrations or API endpoints were added. The findings stay open until a reviewer who didn't write the fix verifies them.

The handback, with the exact diff and test output, is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG1/round-15/T-DG1-BE16-backend-workflow-engineer.md`.
